name: China Steel Corporation
summary: China Steel Corporation is a prominent manufacturer and distributor of steel products, serving markets in Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, China, India, and globally. The company's extensive product line features steel plates, which are integral to construction frameworks, shipbuilding, bridge infrastructure, oil country tubular goods, machinery components, pressure vessels, and specialized climate/corrosion-resistant applications. It also supplies steel bars and wire rods, utilized across general and machine structures, in cold and hot forging processes, for hard-drawn steel wires, and as welding electrodes. Furthermore, China Steel produces hot-rolled coils and sheets, essential for automobile chassis, bridge beams, general construction, road guardrails, steel pipes, pressure vessels, and various landscaping projects. Their cold-rolled coils are specifically engineered for automotive stamping parts and home electronics. These coils are also designed for components requiring high-level forming, such as automobile and scooter parts, a variety of precision engineering (PSE) and structural reinforcement elements, and products necessitating surface treatments like painting, electroplating, or adhesive coatings. Beyond its core steel manufacturing, the corporation offers mechanical, communications, and electrical engineering services, and generates solar power. Established in 1971, China Steel Corporation is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
